raw_response:
This small plot of beans is just a small piece of my land, and beans do not need much fertilizer like maize does because they fix their own nitrogen. I have some formal schooling so I know a little, but money is tight — I will save the chemical fertilizer for my maize plot. I will put some manure from my animals on it, use seed I kept from last season, and my wife and I will work it ourselves. No irrigation here, we depend on the rains like everyone in Ntcheu.
